fieldDescription: How the submarket buttons above the cargo and fleet screens are laid out. Stretched (default): the vanilla number of buttons per row widened to fill the row. Icons only: no names (they still show in the tooltip) and as many buttons per row as fit. Five per row: five buttons with names in each row; names too long for the button are cut short. The storage button always sits in the last column. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.
